text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: GPU pool eu-west-1a >95% used for 4m. Queue growth + sustained token backlog. Autoscaler attempted scale but failed with "scaleup: quota_exceeded". Some requests seeing 429 and increased latency. Paging oncall.
oncall-ops: Ack — taking it. joining bridge in 2m. @infra-ross @sre-eli can you pull autoscaler logs?
sre-eli: looking now. seeing repeated 403 from cloud provider: "RequestedAcceleratorCount exceeds quota". Autoscaler loop kept retrying, hit our max_concurrent_scaleups and backed off.
infra-ross: confirmed. provider quota cap at 20 gpus for the account in region. Pool at 18, attempted +4 -> rejected. Opening quota request now but will take hours.
oncall-ops: Can we do manual reserve/evac? Any spare GPU capacity in other AZs/regions?
ml-anya: eu-west-1b has 6 spare GPUs in dedicated pool but model routing pinned to eu-west-1a. We can temporarily route lower-priority tenants to 1b to absorb burst.
support-jamie: Customer impact: support telemetry shows 3 tenants (cust-125, cust-341, cust-900) with elevated 429s since 22:11 UTC. Trying to identify SLO breaches.
product-lee: We need a public status blurb if >5% of requests are failing. Hold until we know scale/route plan?
infra-ross: Manual scale tweak: I can shutdown a low-priority reserved instance in 1a to free 2 GPUs — doing now: `gcloud compute instances stop reserved-worker-03 --zone=euw1a`.
incident-bot: UPDATE: reserved-worker-03 stopped successfully. Pool free GPUs -> 20. Autoscaler attempted scale; scaleup result: accepted. New nodes provisioning (ETA ~90s).
sre-eli: Autoscaler logs now show successful allocation and kube nodes joining. Queue depth dropping.
oncall-ops: Good. Monitor 15m then start recovering traffic. @support-jamie draft initial status update: "Investigating elevated errors due to GPU provisioning limits; mitigations in progress." :eyes: 
support-jamie: Draft ready, will send to affected customers in 10 min unless ops request hold.
ml-anya: Noted model latency for warm sessions spiked — KV cache misses when we moved swap endpoints. Might need targeted warmups for high-QPS tenants.
infra-ross: Action: submit quota increase request to cloud: ticket #CZ-8241 filed. Also add runbook step to check provider quota before autoscaler spin.
sre-eli: Action: add autoscaler handler to detect quota_exceeded and alert earlier (avoid noisy retries). Filing bug: INF-3912.
oncall-ops: Postmortem notes: immediate mitigation manual stop of reserved instance -> +2 GPUs; fallback routing to eu-west-1b for non-critical tenants; queued customers recovered. No data loss. Followups: quota increase, autoscaler error handling, routing automation for AZ spillover.
product-lee: Please add customer communication timeline and exec summary after 24h.
support-jamie: Sent notifications at 22:28 UTC to impacted customers. Logged in incident tracker.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: pool back to healthy at 22:35 UTC. Closing on-call bridge. :white_check_mark:
